title: Haryana HTET Result 2026
vacancyDetails: Result of HTET 2026 for Primary Teacher (Level-1), TGT (Level-2) and PGT (Level-3) eligibility
qualification: As per HTET level-wise eligibility (D.El.Ed. / B.Ed. / Post Graduation + B.Ed. etc.)
ageLimit: N/A (eligibility test; age applies at recruitment stage)
selectionProcess: HTET Written Examination → Result / Qualifying Status → e-Certificate for qualified candidates
documentsRequired: Roll number, application number; later used for e-certificate download
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bseh.org.in or HTET result portal
2. Open HTET Result 2026
3. Enter roll number / application details
4. Check qualifying status and marks
5. Download e-certificate when link is activated for qualified candidates
shortDescription: Haryana HTET Result 2026 declared for Level 1, 2 and 3. Check marks at bseh.org.in.
content:
The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has declared the Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET) Result 2026.

Candidates who appeared for Level-1 (PRT), Level-2 (TGT) and Level-3 (PGT) can check their marks and qualifying status on the official portal.

Levels

  • Level-1: Primary Teacher (Class I–V)
  • Level-2: TGT (Class VI–VIII)
  • Level-3: PGT (Class IX–XII)

Qualified candidates should download the HTET e-certificate when released. HTET qualifies candidates for teacher recruitment; it is not a job offer by itself.
